name: mcp-competitor-price-stock-changelog-monitor
displayName: Competitor Price, Stock, and Changelog Monitor
description: MCP server for Competitor Price, Stock, and Changelog Monitor. Watch competitor stores and SaaS sites and get only what changed since the last run: price, sale price, and stock per variant, new and removed products, plan prices, and changelog entries. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.
